test_title: PYST 2: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Rohan was now standing on tiptoe to ______ over at the inhabitants of the two beds.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Look'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is** 'look'.** Here's why:
 
• **In this context,** all the four options might seem plausible as they all describe the action of observing something. 
 
• However, their connotations are slightly different, making **'look' **the **best choice**.
 
• **'Look' **is a general term for directing one's gaze towards something. 
 
• It** does not imply** any particular intensity or duration. In the given sentence, Rohan is just trying to see the inhabitants, so 'look' is the most neutral and appropriate word to use.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"Rohan was now standing on tiptoe to **look** over at the inhabitants of the two beds."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are explanations for each word:
 
 
• **'View' **often suggests a more deliberate and extended act of seeing, often associated with observing a scene or landscape. It's not typically used to describe a quick or casual observation, which seems to be the context here.
 
• **'Stare'** implies a more intense, prolonged gaze, often without the other person's awareness or consent. It has a somewhat negative connotation and doesn't quite fit in this context unless Rohan's observation is meant to be intense or impolite.
 
• **'Peep'** generally has a secretive or voyeuristic connotation, implying looking at something that one isn't supposed to. If Rohan is just casually trying to see the inhabitants of the beds, 'peep' might suggest a level of secrecy or intrusion that isn't indicated by the rest of the sentence.
